risk_factors.description: Supplier emissions data varies in format, completeness, and accuracy across 14 countries. Tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers often lack structured emissions reporting capabilities.
risk_factors.mitigation: Implement tiered data quality scoring with automated validation rules. Deploy ML-based gap filling for missing data points. Establish supplier onboarding program with standardized templates.

risk_factors.description: EU CSRD reporting requirements are still being finalized through delegated acts. Format specifications (XBRL taxonomy) may change during the implementation window.
risk_factors.mitigation: Design reporting engine with pluggable format adapters. Monitor EFRAG technical guidance releases monthly. Maintain buffer sprint capacity for regulatory changes.

risk_factors.description: SAP S/4HANA BAPI interfaces have documented rate limits and timeout behaviors that may not support real-time extraction at the required throughput for 2,400 suppliers.
risk_factors.mitigation: Implement adaptive rate limiting with exponential backoff. Design batch extraction windows during off-peak hours. Maintain local cache with 72-hour freshness SLA.

risk_factors.description: Cross-border data flows for supplier information across 14 countries require compliance with GDPR, local data protection laws, and industry-specific regulations.
risk_factors.mitigation: Deploy data residency controls with region-specific storage buckets. Implement PII detection and anonymization at ingestion boundary. Obtain DPA agreements with all data processors.

risk_factors.description: The 72-hour data freshness SLA for tier-1 supplier emissions factors requires high-availability infrastructure with automated failover and monitoring.
risk_factors.mitigation: Design active-passive failover with automated health checks. Implement SLO-based alerting with escalation paths. Maintain operational runbook with incident response procedures.

risk_factors.description: Specialized expertise in GHG Protocol Scope 3 methodology combined with data engineering skills is scarce. Team ramp-up may delay early phases.
risk_factors.mitigation: Engage sustainability consulting partner for methodology validation. Invest in team training program during Foundation phase. Document domain knowledge in ubiquitous language glossary.

risk_factors.description: Optimization phase targets 10x scale (24,000 suppliers) which requires fundamentally different data processing patterns than the initial 2,400 supplier baseline.
risk_factors.mitigation: Design for horizontal scaling from day one. Use streaming architecture (Dataflow) that scales with partition count. Conduct load testing at 5x and 10x during Core Pipeline phase.

recommendations: Establish a dedicated data quality team during Foundation phase
Create regulatory monitoring dashboard for CSRD updates
Negotiate SAP BAPI rate limit increases before Core Pipeline phase
Conduct security architecture review with external auditor in month 3
